frequency_question: How often is a major nominated official confirmed by floor vote within a short compressed timeline (e.g., 30 days) of formal submission?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive branch nominations submitted to the Senate for principal agency head or cabinet positions where a Senate floor confirmation vote occurred or was scheduled within a roughly 30-day window; excludes lower-tier sub-cabinet positions or nominations withdrawn prior to committee action.
coverage_note: 10 named; representative of high-priority executive nominations that reach the floor
known_gaps: Does not fully capture highly controversial nominations that stall indefinitely, though conditional factors account for friction.
skeleton: 10 prominent cabinet/agency nominations from the start of the 2021 transition period tracked for confirmation speed
multiplier: 10 / 10 observed historical baseline for major confirmed nominees
validity_reason: Base rates for Senate confirmation timelines remain stable within the current legislative rules and polarization regime until the next administration cycle.
